messages.text: Mia. I want old globe. Im looking for some interesting countries can you point me to some with one or some of these: rhodesia, yugoslavia, kingdom of italy, west/east Germany

That's a great hobby — but I have to be upfront: our "antique" globes (including the Franklin you were just looking at) are new globes styled with warm, sepia-toned seas for a vintage look, not reproductions of old maps. Per our own FAQ, the cartography reflects current political boundaries at time of manufacture, so none of our current stock would actually show Rhodesia, Yugoslavia, the Kingdom of Italy, or a divided Germany.

If you're after a globe that genuinely shows those historical borders, that would be a vintage/antique collector's piece rather than anything in our current catalog — I'd point you to (email hidden) to ask if they have any true vintage stock, since that's not something I can confirm from what's listed. Is it the look of an old map you're after, or the actual historical borders?

Got it — that means you're after real vintage cartography, not just the antique colour styling. I don't have anything in our current catalog that's confirmed to show those historical borders (Rhodesia, Yugoslavia, Kingdom of Italy, divided Germany), so I don't want to guess. Your best bet is to email (email hidden) and ask directly if they have any genuine vintage-dated globes in stock — they'd know what's in the back room that isn't listed online.
